policies.title: Equatorial Guinean ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Equatorial Guinea as Prior to Arrival, defined as a mission or consulate visa before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Equatorial Guinean passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Equatorial Guinean ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule places Equatorial Guinea in its authorized-visa cohort for advance immigration approval.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Equatorial Guinean passport holder who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa approval may take up to 60 business days and must be granted before travel.
Washington-specific filing mechanics are not generalized to every consular district; final admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Equatorial Guinean ordinary passports: Türkiye advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's live Foreign Ministry table requires a visa for ordinary Equatorial Guinean passports; its eVisa option is expressly conditional on third-country documents and has no visa-on-arrival alternative.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Equatorial Guinean passport holder without the separate qualifying Schengen, United States, United Kingdom or Ireland visa or residence permit.
Qualifying holders may obtain a 30-day single-entry eVisa subject to additional conditions; this does not change the ordinary-passport baseline.
Türkiye's official eVisa FAQ says eligible Equatorial Guinean eVisa applicants are not eligible for visa on arrival. Work, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
